title: ‘The Odyssey’ to Skip Influencer Screenings Ahead of July Release
summary: Universal is passing on traditional word-of-mouth screenings for Christopher Nolan's latest blockbuster.

title: ‘Little Brother’ Review: Eric André Turns John Cena’s Life Upside Down in a Farrelly Brothers-Like Netflix Comedy
summary: The director of "Ingrid Goes West" makes an unexpected return to features with this sweet and silly comedy about long-lost "brothers."

title: How I Cracked the Story for My First Feature Film with a Used Bookstore Find

title: ‘The Get Out’ Review: Russell Crowe Leads a Crime Comedy That’s Neither Funny nor Thrilling
summary: Aaron Paul, Nina Dobrev, and Luke Evans round out the cast of an ensemble crime story that lacks a pulse.

summary: The seasoned TV executive and proven producer knows how to make hits, but she tells IndieWire even she didn't expect the Jane Austen spinoff to be quite such a smash here and across the pond.

title: Guy Maddin Movies Are Made to Look Appalling and Alienating — Now, He Says Audiences ‘Don’t Even Know What a Really Beat-Up Film Looks Like’
summary: The one-of-a-kind Canadian auteur behind "My Winnipeg" and "The Saddest Music in the World" looks back on his work on the eve of an in-person Academy Museum retrospective (and a Film Forum series in New York) that includes a new restoration of "Careful."

title: Remember: These Shows Are Not (Yet) Eligible for Emmys
summary: Although these five TV projects all orbit the Emmy nominations voting window, they are ineligible, and therefore very far off from actually being snubbed.

title: Brad Bird Explains Why He Didn’t Pitch ‘Ray Gunn’ to Pixar

title: ‘The Bear’ Review: Season 5 Cools Things Down for a Hearty Final Course
summary: Told across a single rainy day, the FX drama's final season finds our favorite Chicago restauranteurs striving to earn a Michelin star before the lights go out on The Bear — perhaps for good.

title: ‘Sense and Sensibility’ Trailer: Daisy Edgar-Jones and George MacKay Take on Some Classic Jane Austen Longing
summary: Georgia Oakley directs this new adaptation, which appears to lean on classic themes (longing, duh) with a close emphasis on the bonds of sisterhood.
